tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mi 'khrugs pa'i zhing mchog sgo 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs/

mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣa ya/ gang gi mtshan tsam dran pas nyes pa'i tshogs/ /ma lus drung nas 'byin mdzad bcom ldan 'das/ /mngon par dga' ba'i zhing gi dpal gyur pa/ /rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir thub pa'i dbang pos/ thar pa chen po las/ ngas ni mi 'khrugs 'jig rten dang/ /bde ba can gyi 'jig rten khams/ /shin tu rnam dag mthong ba na/ /sdug bsngal bya ba'i ming yang med/ /zhes sogs mdo sde du ma las kyang bsngags shing*/ khyad par du dkon mchog brtsegs pa nas rgyas par gsungs pa sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs pa'i zhing gi 'byor ba dang*/ der skye ba'i rgyu sogs mdo de las bshad pa rnams bkod na mang bar 'gyur bas/ smon lam gyi ngo bo tsam brjod par bya'o/ /de yang 'di ltar/ shar phyogs sangs rgyas zhing stong phrag gcig nas/ / bde gshegs mi 'khrugs rgyal ba sras bcas rnams/ /'khor bcas thogs pa med pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /'dir gshegs smon pa 'grub pa'i dbang po mdzod/ / sngon tshe 'jig rten kun gyi 'dren pa mchog /spyan ni chen po zhes bya rgyal ba'i drung*/ /dam bcas smon lam ji bzhin yongs rdzogs pa/ /bcom ldan mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod tshogs kun 'bul sdig ltung so sor bshags/ /dge la yi rang chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ /grangs med bskal par yun ring brtan par bzhugs 'dis mtshon dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo/ /rang dang gzhan gyis dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdoms pa'i mthu la brten nas bdag 'chi ba'i dus mngon du gyur pa na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs pa 'khor rgya mtsho lta bus bskor ba'i dbus na lham me lhan ne lhang nger bzhugs pa mngon sum du mthong bar gyur cig /mthong ma thag tu rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa la dmigs pa'i dad pa shugs drag po skyes pa'i mthus shi 'phos te mngon par dga' ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing du skye bar gyur

cig /skyes ma thag tu gzungs dang*/ spobs pa dang*/ mngon par shes pa dang*/ byang chub kyi sems la sogs pa'i yon tan gyi tshogs ma lus pa mngon du gyur te/ rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa la sogs pa'i phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyi thugs mnyes par byas nas de rnams kyis bstan pa'i dam pa'i chos mtha' dag nyan cing 'dzin par gyur cig /de'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs pa'i sras kyi thu bo byang chub sems dpa' spos kyi glang po chen po la sogs pa'i spyod pa ci 'dra ba de 'dra ba'i spyod pa rlabs po che thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed nus par gyur cig /gzhan yang skye ba thams cad du rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pas sngon sangs rgyas spyan chen po'i drung du smon lam ji ltar btab nas mthar phyin par mdzad pa de bzhin du bdag gis kyang sgrub par gyur cig /bdag gang du 'tshang rgya ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing de na/ ngan song gi ming yang mi grags cing*/ shin tu yongs su dag pa dang*/ 'khor phun sum tshogs pa sha stag kun nas 'byung ba sogs snod bcud kyi 'byor ba che ba mngon par dga' ba'i zhing lta bur mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig /nam zhig 'chi ba'i mtshan ma mthong ba'i tshe/ /bde gshegs mi 'khrugs 'khor tshogs rgya mtshor bcas/ /mngon sum mthong nas shugs drag dad pa'i mthus/ /shi 'phos mngon dga'i zhing du skye bar shog /skyes ma thag tu gzungs spobs mngon shes sogs/ /grangs med yon tan tshogs kyis rgyud phyug ste/ /bde gshegs sras dang bcas pa mnyes byas nas/ /rgyal ba'i dam chos ma lus 'dzin par shog /mi 'khrugs rgyal ba'i sras kyi thu bo mchog /byang sems spos kyi glang po che sogs kyi/ /rlabs chen spyod pa ci 'dra de 'dra ba/ /mtha' dag yongs su rdzogs par byed par shog /sngon tshe byang chub sems dpa' mi 'khrugs pas/ /sangs rgyas spyan sngar dam bcas mthar phyin te/

/dag pa'i zhing du mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i/ /zhing mchog de 'drar sangs rgyas 'gyur bar shog /sangs ma rgyas pa'i skye ba thams cad du'ang rtag tu dal 'byor gyi rten rnam par dag pa thob nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa la rab tu byung ste tshul khrims kyi phung po yongs su rdzogs par byed nus par gyur cig /rten de yang rigs gzugs sogs mtho ris kyi yon tan bdun dang ldan zhing rgyal ba'i gsung rab mtha' dag la thos bsam sgom gsum gyis 'jug pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /gzhan yang skye ba thams cad du dag pa'i zhing gang du skyes kyang snying rje shugs drag pos kun nas bslangs te/ ma dag pa'i zhing rnams su yang rdzu 'phrul gyis thogs med du bgrod nas sems can rang rang gi skal pa dang 'tsham pa'i chos bstan pa la brten nas rgyal ba'i lam bzang rnam par dag pa la 'god nus par gyur cig /de ltar 'god pa la thabs mkhas pa'i mkhyen rab thogs pa med par 'jug pa'i sgo nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad kyi mthar phyin pa rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs lta bur gyur cig /snying rje'i go cha btsan pos rgyal sras kyi spyod pa rlabs po che mtha' dag la zhum pa med par slob pa'i sgo nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad kyi pha rol tu son pa rje btsun spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug lta bur gyur cig /byang chub kyi spyod pa'i gegs su gyur pa bdud dang mu stegs dang phas kyi rgol ba'i tshogs thams cad thogs med du 'joms par byed nus pa'i sgo nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad kyi mthar son pa rje btsun gsang ba'i bdag po lta bur gyur cig /gzhan yang skye ba thams cad du ma dag pa'i zhing gi 'gro ba 'dul ba la mnyam med shākya'i rgyal ba dang*/ lus dang sems kyi nad thams cad 'joms par byed pa la bde bar gshegs pa sman gyi bla ma dang*/ dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba thams cad 'joms par byed pa la rgyal ba tshe dpag tu med pa lta bur gyur cig

/gzhan yang skye ba thams cad du dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i drung du gsung rab mtha' dag la thos pa ngoms med du byas nas don thams cad khong du chud de nyams su len pa'i sgo nas rgyal ba'i dam chos ma lus pa yongs su 'dzin pa la chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa lta bur gyur cig /mdor na bdag nyid sdug bsngal gsum gyis mnar ba de bzhin du sems can thams cad kyang de 'dra bar mthong ba'i snying rje chen pos yid bskul te/ bskal pa grangs med pa rnams su yang rgyal sras kyi spyod pa la slob dgos kyang sems can thams cad kyi don sgrub pa la zhum pa'i blo nam yang mi skye zhing spro bar 'jug pa'i sgo nas rgyal ba'i go 'phang bde blag tu thob par gyur cig /ji srid go 'phang mchog de ma thob par/ de srid dal 'byor tshang ba'i rten rnyed nas/ /rab tu byung ste tshul khrims phung po sogs/ /yon tan ma lus yongs su 'dzin par shog /dag pa'i zhing du skyes kyang ma dag pa'i/ /lus can ma lus 'dren par byed pa la/ /rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter dang thugs rje'i bdag /mthu stobs dbang phyug nyid dang mtshungs par shog /snyigs ma'i 'gro ba'i 'dren mchog shākya'i tog /sdug bsngal dug gsum nad sel sman gyi bla/ /dus min 'chi ba 'joms mdzad tshe dpag med/ /mdzad pa ci 'dra de bzhin bdag gyur cig /skye ba kun du dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis/ /yongs su bzung nas rgyal ba'i dam chos kun/ /bshad sgrub gnyis kyis yongs su 'dzin pa la/ /chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa bzhin shog /mdor na rang nyid sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba/ /de bzhin sems can kun la mtshungs mthong ba'i/ /snying rje chen pos yid rab drang pa'i mthus/ /ma zhum spyod pas byang chub sgrub par shog /shākya'i dbang po 'dren pa 'od dpag med/ /zhes sogs kyang brjod do/ /zhes mi 'khrugs pa'i zhing mchog sgo 'byed ces bya ba 'di ni/

gdams pa spyi dang khyad par du snga 'gyur theg pa la mkhas pa'i rnam dpyod can dge slong rgyal mtshan dpal bzang gis bskul ba'i ngo bor/ snyom las pa shākya'i dge slong rab 'byams smra ba bshad sgrub ming can gyis dkon brtsegs dang rje btsun btsong kha pa chen po'i legs bshad la brten nas bgyis pa lags so/ /smras pa/ ji ltar mdo sde dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ /bskal bzang byang sems stong phrag rnams kyi nang*/ khyod 'dra gcig kyang med ces rab bsngags pa/ /sngon gyi rgyal ba'i sras po mi 'khrugs pa/ /zhing mchog mngon par dga' bar sangs rgyas nas/ /slar yang bde gshegs mi 'khrugs dbang por grags/ /gang gi mtshan bzung sangs rgyas gzhan dag mtshan/ /bzung las lhag ces mdo sde las ni bshad/ /gang de'i 'khor dang zhing gi 'byor pa rnams/ /ji bzhin brjod par nus pa ma yin zhes/ /gsungs pas bde bar gegs pa'i yon tan kun/ /rdzogs par brjod par bdag ltas ga la nus/ /'on kyang blo ldan 'ga' yis bskul ba'i ngor/ mkha' lding 'phur shus byi'us 'jug pa bzhin/ /mkhas dbang nyi zla bgrod shul me khyer bdag /cung zad 'jug la dam bas mi khrel snyam/ /brjod bya don gyi lang tsho mi dman yang*/ /rjod byed tshig gi rgyan gyis ma spras shing*/ /byed po 'khor slob grogs 'byor gyis dben pas/ /nyes par smras pa'i rdul gyis cis mi gos/ /de lta na yang legs bshad chu 'dzin las/ /mngon par byung ba'i dge legs char gyi rgyun/ /dus gsum dge tshogs gaṅgā'i chu klung dang*/ /lhan cig kun mkhyen rgya mtsho chen por bsngo/ /rgyal sras kun gyi gtsug rgyan kun tu bzang*/ /smon lam bzang po spyod pa bzang po mchog /longs su rdzogs par 'grub pa'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bde blag thob byed lam 'dis thob gyur cig /bdag kyang deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /mi 'khrugs rgyal ba'i zhing du skyes nas kyang*/

/smon lam 'di dag thams cad rab rdzogs te/ /'gro ba'i don du sangs rgyas 'gyur bar shog / ces kyang smras so// bkra shis// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/mi 'khrugs pa'i zhing mchog sgo 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs/ -PAGE 88--PAGE 87--PAGE 82-
